bias.en: Uptrend under pressure · on the 100-day average
bias.zh: 上升趋势承压 · 位于 100 日均线

read.en: AMD fell 6.0% on Oct 16 to $528.75, its third straight decline. It is below the 5-day ($572.3), 10-day ($601.7) and 30-day ($578.2) averages, just above the rising 100-day ($525.7), and well above the 200-day ($394.3). MACD has been below its signal since Oct 9 and is still above zero with a widening gap, Parabolic SAR has been bearish since Oct 8 ($624.3), and RSI is 37.8.
read.zh: AMD 10月16日下跌 6.0%，收于 $528.75，连续第三日下跌。股价位于 5 日（$572.3）、10 日（$601.7）和 30 日均线（$578.2）下方，略高于上行的 100 日均线（$525.7），并远高于 200 日均线（$394.3）。MACD 自 10月9日起位于信号线下方，仍在零轴之上，差距扩大，抛物线 SAR 自 10月8日起看空（$624.3），RSI 为 37.8。

read.en: The $530 Oct 15 low broke and is now first resistance, but the drop stopped at the $525–527 zone (100-day average, August pivot). Above $530 are $568–572 (Oct 14 low, 5-day average) and $578 (30-day). Support is $525, then $495–498 (late-June and early-July lows) and $480 (Sep 14 low). A close below $525 would open $497; a close above $572 would target $578.
read.zh: $530 的 10月15日低点失守并成为第一阻力，但跌势止于 $525–527 区域（100 日均线、8月转折点）。$530 上方为 $568–572（10月14日低点、5 日均线）和 $578（30 日均线）。支撑为 $525，其次 $495–498（6月下旬和 7月初低点）和 $480（9月14日低点）。若收盘跌破 $525，下一目标看 $497；若收盘站上 $572，目标看 $578。

s.en: 100-day average ($525.7) and August pivot; Oct 16 low $526.8
